subject.title: fix(ui): make session history accessible in picker and sidebar

question: Should this PR remain the canonical combined fix for the VoiceOver-friendly session-history tracker, or should it be narrowed while picker/sidebar rename controls continue in sibling PRs?
rationale: The live diff no longer matches the older combined rename-control proof/body, and overlapping open PRs still cover narrower picker and sidebar rename slices; automation cannot choose the final accessible session-history UX scope.

options.title: Narrow And Repair This PR
options.body: Treat this branch as the derived-title and sidebar-accessibility slice, fix the derived-title refresh regression, and update the proof/body to the live head.

options.title: Restore Combined Scope
options.body: Ask the contributor to restore current-head picker/sidebar rename controls and proof so this PR can own the full accessibility tracker.

options.title: Pause For Sibling Sequencing
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers choose among the open picker-rename and sidebar-rename candidates.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Repair This PR
recommendation.body: Treat this branch as the derived-title and sidebar-accessibility slice, fix the derived-title refresh regression, and update the proof/body to the live head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work in the same sidebar/session capability area is the clearest routing signal for the scope decision.
